findings.detail: Eighteen earlier-period position facts were retained under the 2026-03-31 report date; the Arise row demonstrates the comparative fact differs from the current schedule row.

rationale: The raw filing has separate current and comparative investment schedules. Arise Holdings is shown in the current schedule at table 34 row 23 with an 8.16% rate and fair value 3,416, while table 61 row 11 shows the earlier-period version at 8.24% (PIK) and fair value 3,795. The flagged records explicitly carry earlier source periods but were retained under report_date 2026-03-31, so PP03 correctly identifies a comparative-period contamination defect. No aggregate anchor is needed for this row-localized purity check.
